title: ML Foundations — Ten Methods, Built and Defended
description: Classical machine learning built from scratch in NumPy, then checked against scikit-learn. Per method: a lesson, an interactive notebook with self-checks, an interview hub of nine questions across three experience tiers, and a spoken rehearsal. Covers linear and logistic regression, kNN, naive Bayes, trees, random forests, gradient boosting, SVM, k-means and PCA. IN PROGRESS: 1 of 10 modules complete.
author: Vinod Seth
